display_long_description:
# **INFO 🧾**
This is **horizon** and it includes many unique and **original features** to make you have the **best time when playing**! 🎮

# **HUB 👾**
Hub is the area on where you spawn! **You are provided** **with a computer** to join lobbies with your friends, **change your name** and **change the colour of your fur! 👀**

# **FOREST 🌲**
**The beloved map of horizon** goof around, play the piano, bounce on the trampoline, leap from each branch! **And so much more.**

# **STORE 🛍️**
In here **you can buy anything between your fingertips!** Purchase the cosmetic of your choice and **check it out by the mirror,** and make sure to welcome Jamarcus! 👤

# **LAVA 🌋**
**Lava is a gamemode,** inside of the hub there is a gamemode board, **pick between casual or lava** If you were to pick lava then **you’d have the funnest time with the rising lava! 🔥**

# **ADDITIONAL INFO 💬**
**You must listen to the rules** by either joining the discord or checking out the rule board and **if you were to break it you would face a period of being banned** where you are disabled to play the game. 📔

**And this game will update every week** so make sure to check out the new update by **checking the game out everyday! 🗓️**
